## c1036781e9c5

**Reproduced semantic defect — bbox area disagrees with authority component size.** The generator documentation and `self_check` say to choose the largest frame by bounding-box area. The selected Racket authority sorts connected frame-colour objects by number of cells. The following accepted 10×16 input separates those criteria (`0` omitted only visually; the exact numeric grid is in `checks/audit/c1036781e9c5/input.json`):

```text
2000000000000000
0111111110000000
0100000010000000
0111111110000000
0000000000111110
0000000000100010
0000000000102010
0000000000100010
0000000000111110
0000000000000000
```

Colour 1 is the most frequent nonzero colour. The 3×8 outline has 18 component cells and bbox area 24. The 5×5 outline has 16 component cells and bbox area 25. The current generator `self_check` returns `[]` and therefore selects the 5×5 frame by area. The supported Racket authority instead returns the recoloured 3×8 frame:

```text
22222222
20000002
22222222
```

The documented bbox-area rival would return the 5×5 crop:

```text
22222
20002
20202
20002
22222
```

The outputs disagree. Source-bound evidence is `checks/audit/c1036781e9c5/racket.json` and `rival.json`; it records generator SHA-256 `b813611cfa36f8764b48f22a4386d297d15588707b6b125b50eefd77f97e1b65`, executed rule hash `1dd093682a87`, and a valid Racket output. The normal sampler does not emit this trade-off because its optional small frame is strictly smaller in both dimensions, so bbox area and perimeter cell count always rank the same. This audit target was not modified.
